name: work2future Young Adult Program
what_you_do: You can get career advising and job readiness workshops. You can get paid work experience. You can also connect with employers in Santa Clara County.
who_can_apply: Santa Clara County residents ages 16 to 24 who are low-income and have at least one barrier to employment or education.
pay_detail: Paid work experience; the page says you can earn up to $25 an hour.
how_to_apply: Call the San Jose Job Center at 408-794-1101 or the Gilroy center at 408-758-3477 and ask about the young adult program.
notes: San Jose Works, a partner program, is also on the page. The page gives ages 14 to 18 for its Paid Work Experience Program and ages 16 to 29 for other city services. Income and barrier rules apply. The page does not say whether job centers are by appointment only. It does not say whether the other services are free.
